title: Inter: 13 Press Claims This Week, Only 3 Held Up | Nerazzurri Daily
description:
The Italian papers made 13 claims about Inter this week. Three held up, ten are still open.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=75

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

REPORTED — Çalhanoğlu's future: Gazzetta dello Sport wanted him signed by the new year (Nov 10), Sky Sport Italia had Juventus waiting on a free (Nov 13), Sabah reported a Fenerbahçe bid of €10m (Nov 14). Still open.
REPORTED — Carlos Augusto's renewal: Nicolò Schira said it was stuck on money (Nov 10), Sky Sport Italia called it close two days later (Nov 12). Inter have announced nothing. Still open.
CONFIRMED — Bastoni was not the booked player: Sky Sport Italia reported the San Siro screen was wrong (Nov 12), and Inter.it named him in Italy's squad for Brussels (Nov 15).
THE TALLY — 3 of 13 reported claims confirmed, 10 still open, none denied. Editions No. 69 to No. 75.

Read today's edition: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/p/edition-75/
